data.long_meaning: The meaning of Oziah is recorded in name-lists as “Help of God”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Oziah total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
